Check your whole project

A shop can only upgrade once every plugin is ready. Sylius Upgrade Analyzer (open source, MIT) checks each plugin in your composer.json along with the rest of the breaking changes, whatever PHP version your project runs:

docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/project" ghcr.io/pierrearthurdemengel/sylius-upgrade-analyzer

Planning the upgrade before Sylius 1.14 security support ends on 31 December 2026? I offer a free migration assessment.

Data from Packagist, refreshed every week (last update: 14 November 2026). Method and full dataset: study on Zenodo · source code.

Maintained by Pierre-Arthur Demengel, Symfony and Sylius developer, author of Sylius Upgrade Analyzer. Spotted a mistake? Open an issue.
